objective: Establish the architecture and SDLC baseline, make authority ownership machine-checkable, and converge fragmented active working-context implementations behind ContextFabric before any CLM model training.

rulesConsidered: Every non-trivial repository change follows the Team Change Gate.
Exactly one canonical owner exists per authority domain.
Models may propose or advise but cannot become sovereign production authority.
Unproven evidence must not be represented as PASS.
Workers remain least-privilege and execution remains Guardian-gated.
Production artifacts remain behind F07 verification and release authorization.
ContextFabric is working-context authority only; it cannot grant capabilities, issue leases, admit economics, verify F07, or own artifact identity.

changes: Added machine-readable canonical authority registry and bound it from the .okf manifest.
Locked Architecture/SDLC baseline and migration boundary for Context Fabric.
Added ContextFabric and ContextFabricContracts as the single active working-context facade.
Reused ActiveContextManager, ContextIndexer and ContextCompiler as internal primitives.
Added deterministic workspace hashing, versioning and stale edit rejection.
Wired CognitivePlaneEngine through ContextFabric while retaining a compatibility alias for existing consumers.
Added blocking authority/context contract CI and dedicated tests.
Explicitly deferred CLM training, durable Mongo context persistence and direct ContextOS consumer migration to later gated waves.

verificationResults.note: Fresh repository and governance checks are still required on the exact PR head before merge.
